method: Actual production rendering at 1920×1080. Earned campaign saves restore portraits/settlement; built-in battle fixtures and actual keyboard commands exercise combat. Normal Game.update advances all positions, animation and HP/MP; no sprite pose, damage or screenshot pixels are assigned. Import-contact-sheet diagnostics are a separate test.
